meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的固定规则来写可渲染的 HTML 视频项目:用 `data-*` 属性标注时间,用单一暂停时间线,让视频/音频播放由框架接管,并遵守禁止随机、禁止无限循环等确定性规则。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 创建 HyperFrames 视频项目、写组合 HTML,或制定 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划时,该技能会触发。写组合 HTML 前它会先读取这套契约。

say.text: 帮我生成最小的可渲染 HyperFrames 组合 HTML。
给这个动画加上轨道时间,并跑 `hyperframes check` 验证。
把这个组合改成子组合并保持 ID 一致。

howto.what_en: Claude will write renderable HTML video projects following the HyperFrames composition contract: timing via `data-*` attributes, a single paused timeline per composition, framework-owned media playback, and deterministic-render rules (no random, no infinite repeats).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to create a HyperFrames project, write composition HTML, or draft a STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan; it reads the contract first.

say_en.text: Generate a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition HTML for me.
Add track timing to this animation and run `hyperframes check` to validate it.
Turn this composition into a sub-composition while keeping the IDs consistent.
say_en.note: Per sub-compositions rules, wrap it in a `<template>`.
